settings.markdown:
## What we ask
- Combat 120+ and a gear setup you're happy to bring
- Discord with a working microphone for raids
- Show up when you sign up, and tell us when you can't

## What you get
- Weekly teaching trips for every raid and most group bosses
- Split loot, always, and a drop log that remembers your best day
- People to kill things with at any hour

items.q: I've never raided. Can I still join?
items.a: Yes. Tell us in the Discord and you'll be on the next teaching trip.
Always, unless the team agrees otherwise before the kill.
Turn up to something once a month. Life comes first; just let us know.
